10 ٱسْتَأْوَيْتُهُ I asked him, or desired him, to compassionate me, or have mercy on me; syn. ٱسْتَرْحَمْتُهُ. (T.) A poet (namely, Dhu-r-Rummeh, TA) says, “وَلَوْ أَنَّنى ٱسْتَأْوَيْتُهُ مَا أَوَى لِيَا
” [And if I had asked him, or desired him, to compassionate me, he would not have compassionated me]. (T, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
